page: Hetzner Cloud cx23 is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the cx family, running on the QEMU hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon CPU with 2 vCPUs and 2 physical cores under a shared CPU allocation model. The processor operates at a base speed of 2.0 GHz and is equipped with 32 KB L1d cache, 4 MB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512F, AES cryptography, and BMI2. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 1.95 GB per core, and includes 40 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Performance benchmarks position the cx23 in the lower tier of cloud instances. In CPU-intensive evaluations, the server achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1028.88 and a multi-core score of 2016.78, both placing in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show read speeds of 149.36 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 20.91 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 16.93 GB/sec. Cryptographic and database operations also reflect entry-level capabilities, with a Passmark database score of 1050.39 and Redis SET performance reaching 2.52 million operations per second.

Given its shared CPU architecture and modest resource allocation, the cx23 offers high qualitative cost efficiency for resource-light applications. It is best suited for development environments, low-traffic static web serving, lightweight background workers, and basic testing pipelines where high-performance compute is not required.
